attribution_policy: Graph-contributed gain requires captured B membership/rank/propagated-reference flow and deterministic RRF ablation showing the necessary-evidence/witness gain disappears without B. Seed-only rank carryover must be reported separately; no propagation claim from seed status alone. Noise/hub/dilution classifications require demonstrated necessary-evidence/overtaker consequence, not raw degree/score. B-only poor ordering does not itself select hybrid failure.

canonical_bm25.analyzer: Native Unicode word spans/casefold, distinct query terms
canonical_bm25.maximum_results: All positive matches, bound = frame resource count
canonical_bm25.score: Native content BM25 + .25 independent filename-stem BM25

comparisons.reference: Whole exact task canonical BM25, unchanged separate lane; never treatment/rescue

decision_rule.bounds: Baseline-complete selected depths remain complete; 5*C_depth <= 6*A_depth AND C-A <= 5; baseline-reached REQUIRED ranks retained, 5*C_rank <= 6*A_rank AND C-A <= 10; every regression independently bounded
decision_rule.burden_scope: Selected mandatory witness prefixes only; union resources/bytes across obligations, retain repeated occurrences and obligation-relative labels; no fictional global task ranking
decision_rule.implementation_checks: Native RI frame/content/support, reference-only projection, occurrence count/sqrt/row arithmetic, seed sources/K/uniform mass, dangling/restart/convergence, full positive ranks/ties, RRF union/arithmetic, exact native joins, unchanged reference lane, once-only execution and valid blind gold
decision_rule.meaningful_witness: A incomplete and C complete OR A_depth > 0 AND 5*C_depth <= 4*A_depth
precedence: REQUIRED resource/cell/unit reach loss OR baseline completion loss OR any unbounded required rank/selected depth regression => GRAPH_HARMFUL
Valid and no loss/unbounded regression, graph-contributed meaningful witness gain or REQUIRED reach rescue AND (strong burden improvement OR safe material reach gain) => GRAPH_HYBRID_SUPPORTED
No loss/unbounded regression, graph-contributed meaningful rank/witness gain or novel REQUIRED reach rescue => COMPLEMENTARY_GRAPH_VALUE
decision_rule.reach_rescue: A REQUIRED cell unreached and C reached, minimum one cell; no fabricated A rank; resource/unit reach also retained
decision_rule.safe_material_gain: At least one graph-contributed REQUIRED-cell reach rescue, no baseline-complete depth or baseline-reached REQUIRED-rank worsening, no required-unit reach loss
decision_rule.selected_witness: Minimum complete depth, then stable reviewed witness identity; never mix members from alternative witnesses
decision_rule.strong_burden: Positive baseline unique and occurrence counts; (10*C_unique <= 9*A_unique OR 10*C_occurrences <= 9*A_occurrences) AND all unique/occurrence/distinct-byte dimensions nonincreasing
decision_rule.zero_resource_witness: Complete at depth 0, zero prefix/burden, task-backed units unranked; 0-to-0 not meaningful, no division

definition_projection: Referenced native definitions in positively ranked owners; definition/subject identity, name, exact native span, incoming per-reference flow and parent resource rank/score. No symbol aggregation changes resource ranks.
diagnostics: Top-K overlap/entered/exited/inversions at 10/20/50, labels only after blind gold
Seed versus propagated mass/rank share, top incoming contributors and responsible reference identifiers
Structural distance from seeds after ranking only
A/B native rank contributions to C; removing B from frozen RRF (A order) explains hybrid movement without a new treatment

frame_policy.eligibility: Broad committed source/test/docs/config; exclude experiments, tests/experiments, research/reports/ledger, held-out/operational paths before content reads
frame_policy.prior_case_text: Exclude whole resource containing case[_ -]?00\d\d marker; never strip natural content

fusion.dependence: B seeded by A; agreement is not independent corroboration
fusion.ties: Descending score, lexical rank (missing infinity), canonical address

gold_policy.natural_text: Unchanged; no treatment-origin metadata or text rewriting
gold_policy.reviewers: One clean primary; no automatic second reviewer/reconciliation

graph_projection.call_import_tags: Native reference qualification/Call tags only; no separate edge or weight
graph_projection.edges: REFERENCER_RESOURCE -> DEFINER_RESOURCE for each positive resolved declaration Reference; retain self references
graph_projection.no_paths: No BFS/frontier/path enumeration generates or scores candidates; optional distance only after ranking, not effectiveness metric
graph_projection.nodes: Every eligible observed repository resource occurrence, address order, bound N
graph_projection.normalization: weight / fsum(outgoing pair weights), canonical source/target order
graph_projection.provenance: Retain native fact objects unmodified; compact serialization retains fact/derivation/occurrence/subject/definition/route/content identities, spans, identifier expression and full native route support. Derived identity is not a replacement for support.
graph_projection.raw_count: Distinct native resolved reference occurrences per directed resource pair; duplicate identical fact counts once, conflicting same-occurrence facts rejected

historical_comparison: Later compare retained Graph-1/2 expansion size, ranked concentration, novel evidence yield, path explosion, reverse/fan-out noise and discovered required evidence; nonmatched cases prohibit a controlled causal superiority claim. No historical rerun or raw path-count effectiveness metric.

map_diagnostic.budget: Whole lines in parent-rank / incoming-flow / definition-identity order, stop at first blocked line; omissions metadata; no token estimator
map_diagnostic.owner_boundary: Experiment rendering only; production Context representation remains a later decision
map_diagnostic.representation: Exact first native declaration line excerpt plus explicit excerpt marker, name/address/location; not complete signature/body/decorators

measurement_semantics.burden: Only selected mandatory owning-query prefixes. Count repeated resources per query separately; distinct resource/UTF-8 byte union counts each exact content occurrence once. Label occurrences against their own obligation; all candidate/gold joins must validate.
measurement_semantics.candidate_safety: A/B membership may differ; C=union(A,B) with full frame-size result bound. No retrospective pruning or candidate removal. Compare reach, noise and concentration only after blind gold.
measurement_semantics.incomplete_burden: Report incomplete obligations separately; strong burden comparison not eligible if either arm has an incomplete selected mandatory obligation. A-incomplete/C-complete may still support through safe material reach rescue or complementary value, never fictional baseline completion burden.
measurement_semantics.indispensability: Obligation intersection of reviewed minimal witnesses; task intersection of reviewed complete task combinations; task-backed units have no rank
measurement_semantics.joins: Exact case/task/obligation/query/repository/snapshot/corpus/address/document/content identity; no filename-only mapping; Q1-Q6 own O1-O6 respectively
measurement_semantics.resource_reach: Distinct REQUIRED union resources reached in owning REQUIRED cells; cell reach is owning-query membership, never rank under another obligation
measurement_semantics.unit_reach: A repository-supported unit is reached when one complete reviewed support alternative is reached under its owning obligation query; never mix members from different alternatives. Task-backed units are available from task, have no retrieval rank; report repository-supported and all units separately.
measurement_semantics.witnesses: For each reviewed witness independently, all repository members must be reached; depth=max owning-query ranks, empty witness=0; incomplete=None. Prefix occurrences are owning-query ranks 1..depth. Select minimum complete depth then reviewed stable identity; no complete witness means incomplete, no fabricated prefix/depth.

metrics: Required repository-supported and all semantic-unit reach (task-backed units unranked)
Every reviewed witness completion depth and stable minimum complete selected witness per obligation
Every REQUIRED-cell rank, gain, regression and reach rescue
Graph-novel REQUIRED / HELPFUL_ONLY / UNNECESSARY resources after gold
A-only, B-only, A intersection B, C union and graph-novel resources before labels
Selected completion-prefix union unique resources, repeated occurrences, duplicate occurrences
Distinct UTF-8 resource bytes in selected prefix union
Captured single-run execution/preparation/publication cost without outcome threshold

pagerank.convergence: L1 delta <= tolerance, deterministic supplied node/row order; normalize returned mass. Nonconvergence is PAGERANK_APPLICATION_DEFECT; no silent fallback or parameter change.
pagerank.result: All positive resource mass bounded by N; descending score then canonical address (no lexical-rank tie preference)
pagerank.trace: Exact/lexical seed provenance, score, seed flag, direct restart, dangling return, incoming edge stationary flows. Edge flow divided equally among its native occurrences for definition diagnostics; scores are not relevance probabilities.
